h1: Solutions for every salon type: nail, hair, lash, spa
lead: Every kind of salon works differently. Here is what SalonGo does for each, even if you only rent a chair.

nail.title: Nail salon management software
nail.lead: Many technicians, many short services, lots of tips. SalonGo keeps each technician's calendar and works out pay at month end.

pairs.problem: Clients message all day asking for a time
pairs.answer: Your own booking link, clients pick a free time themselves

pairs.problem: Commission and tips worked out by hand
pairs.answer: Pay by percentage or fixed salary, tips per client or split equally
Receipts are sent to EET at checkout, no extra till needed

nail.alt: Nail technicians' pay by percentage and tips in SalonGo

hair.title: Booking software for hair salons
hair.lead: Cut, colour, perm: each service takes its own time. The calendar uses the real duration, so nothing overlaps.

pairs.answer: Each service has its own duration and price, the calendar fits it in
Clients choose a stylist when booking, or let the app pick whoever is free
Confirmation email and a reminder 1 hour before

hair.alt: A hair salon's calendar per stylist in SalonGo

beauty.title: Software for lash, spa and beauty salons
beauty.lead: Clients come back in cycles. Client records and offer emails bring them back at the right time.

pairs.problem: Not remembering what the client had last time
pairs.answer: Client record: service history, visits, spend
Filter lapsed clients and send them an offer email
The app reminds you 2 days ahead so you can send wishes with an offer

beauty.alt: Client list of a lash and spa salon in SalonGo

chain.title: Software for salon chains with multiple locations
chain.lead: One account for every salon. The owner sees revenue and bookings for all locations on one page.

pairs.problem: Calling each salon to ask about revenue
pairs.answer: All salons page: revenue, bookings, online bookings waiting
Check on your phone any time; staff have their own logins

pairs.problem: Every salon is a different size
pairs.answer: Each location picks a plan by staff count and renews on its own

chain.alt: All salons page: revenue per location in SalonGo

desk.title: Checkout software for chair renters with their own IČO
desk.lead: The Chair plan has only checkout, receipts, income and expenses, and EET in your name. The salon owner cannot see your revenue.
desk.note: No calendar or payroll. Switch to Basic any time you need them.
desk.alt: Chair plan checkout on a phone

items.q: Is SalonGo right for a small salon?
items.a: Yes. Basic covers {staffBasic} staff and 1 location with every salon tool except email marketing. When the team grows, switch plans any time.
Basic, Pro and Premium have the same salon tools and differ by staff per location, number of locations and email marketing: none on Basic, 50 clients a day on Pro, unlimited on Premium.

items.q: Which languages can clients book in?
items.a: The booking page is in Czech, Slovak, German, English and French. You and your staff can use the app in Vietnamese.

items.q: Which plan does a chair renter need?
items.a: Renters with their own IČO use the Chair plan, {priceDesk} CZK a month, with EET on their own certificate. Salon employees don't need it: the owner adds them to the salon's account.

closing.title: Try it for {days} days, then pick the plan that fits
closing.lead: No card needed. Support in Vietnamese and Czech.
